title: Ethiopian Velvety Soup
description: A rich and creamy vegetarian soup with an Ethiopian twist, made with velvety texture and a variety of spices.

ingredients.name: Velvety
ingredients.notes: Used to give the soup a creamy texture

instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, carrots, and potatoes. Cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the Ethiopian spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the velvety to give the soup a creamy texture.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
